mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing modafinil plasma concentrations and CNS effects, while modafinil may induce hepatic metabolism affecting isoniazid efficacy.
action: Monitor for modafinil toxicity (headache, anxiety, insomnia) and isoniazid efficacy; consider modafinil dose reduction if CNS adverse effects emerge and ensure tuberculosis treatment response.
